description: Physical flow - by border is a dataset listed in Elia open data platform, an open data platform of a transmission system operator, published or maintained by Elia Group. The physical energy flows on the interconnections between the Belgian bidding zone and the neighbouring bidding zones. A positive figure means export from Belgium, while negative figure means import into Belgium. Coverage: Belgium. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Transmission. Its keywords are Exchanges, Flows, EU Reg. No 534/2013. The portal shows 2025-06-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Elia Open Data Licence (/pages/licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-elia-open-data-portal.
